messages:
ana (product): Announcement: Aurora Streamline is GA on Hosted API. This release focuses on predictable streaming for multi-tenant apps: per-tenant policy controls, soft-fail fallback routing, and compact structured chunks for faster parsing. Regions: rolling to us-east-1 & eu-central-1 today, other regions over the next 72h. Docs + migration: https://redwood.example.com/aurora-streamline-ga

patch-bot: rollout started aurora-streamline@stable at 2635000120 :rocket:

derek (eng-runtime): New canonical endpoint: POST /v2/streamline. Header X-RW-Streamline: 1 opts you into the compact chunk format. Clients can open long-lived connections and multiplex conversations via conversation_id. Back-compat: we'll accept legacy /v1/stream connections for 120 days, but they will not get predictive routing or soft-fail.

lucas (devex): Quick example for JS: 

```
const conn = client.streamline.connect({model: 'aurora-slim-6b', conversation_id: 'team-X-1'});
conn.on('chunk', c => parseCompact(c));
```

Curl sample: 

```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
  -H "X-RW-Streamline: 1" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"conversation_id":"team-X-1","model":"aurora-slim-6b"}' 
  https://api.redwood.com/v2/streamline
```

marlene (eng-platform): Platform notes: per-tenant policy keys allow rate caps, token budgets, and tool-call allowlists. Enable via Console -> Projects -> Policies. We added an API: POST /v1/projects/:id/policies to programmatically set limits. Soft-fail routing will automatically fallback to a compatible lite model if high contention is detected.

hannah (eng-sre): Observability: new Streamline dashboard + heatmap. Default alerts: sustained p95 latency > 450ms for 5m, error rate > 1% for 3m. Pre-warming pools for aurora-slim-6b to target cold-starts < 100ms p95. We'll watch the fallback rate metric closely during rollout.

patch-bot: deploy complete aurora-streamline@stable at 2635000205 :white_check_mark:

paul (docs): Migration guide and compatibility matrix live: https://redwood.example.com/docs/aurora-migrate. Note: compact chunk format includes a top-level "_meta" block and an array "chunks"; please parse _meta first to support incremental parsing. We added parsing helpers in JS/Python SDKs and example server-side ingestion code.

ravi (customer-success): Scheduling customer outreach: we'll email self-serve customers with simple migration steps and host two office hours next Tue/Wed. Dedicated/private customers get a staged migration plan; reach out if you need a runbook.

ana (ana, product): Deprecation timeline: /v1/stream will be maintained for 120 days then deprecated. We'll publish exact sunset dates in 30-day and 7-day notices. If your product/team needs an extended migration window, please open a ticket with eng-platform. Thanks all :tada:
